A Claude fork replays the exact evidence-selected native transcript. Owner pressure and a byte estimate can read below their threshold while that transcript already ends in a synthetic provider `Prompt is too long` rejection. Forking that source inherits the wall. A kickoff receipt and live host registration establish delivery and liveness; a synthetic rejected assistant entry establishes neither a usable answer nor consult recovery.

WI-10006539 measured this in the original revision2 composition-rig acceptance consult: the copied source transcript `8846f615-0833-489b-b3fb-0930ff5da385.jsonl` ends in two synthetic `invalid_request` / `<synthetic>` / `Prompt is too long` records. Answering fork `d1c1e2ee-7f81-4f3b-8e85-ee1767d74493.jsonl` received the exact current request and repeated the same rejection. The saved launch log renders `Context limit reached · /clear to continue`.

The repair extends the maintained Claude transcript analyzer and native dispatch preflight. Only synthetic provider records count. A new submitted prompt or tool result preserves the context wall; valid model output or a native `compact_boundary` clears it. The preflight skips affected fork ranks and leaves the configured conversion ranks eligible. The first-reply guard stops an answering fork whose first response is a provider context rejection, then continues the existing rank walk. The launch-log detector recognizes actual terminal error output and excludes a request merely quoting the error.

Conventional regression guards live in `claude-resume-tool-references.test.ts` and `consult/consult-dispatch.test.ts`; run them with `npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/claude-resume-tool-references.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/consult/consult-dispatch.test.ts`. Quoted prose, tool results, successful compaction, first-reply failure and conversion continuation are distinct controls.

Local verification is 133 passing tests and a clean named-file typecheck. The durable receipt is `docs/evidence/composition-rig-canonical-adoption-2026-10-06.json`. Committed-source proof and genuine original native review settlement are separate requirements. This source repair does not change provider ranks, model, account, carry, runtime controls, routine configuration or reviewer allocation, and does not supply an acceptance verdict.
